VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.label: spatialist
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.description: Spatialists fold space into pockets of their own, carrying a private room with them wherever they go.
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.tooltip: Spatialists fold space into a personal pocket dimension and open a gate to it wherever they stand. Anyone can walk through an open gate, so the pocket serves the whole colony as storage that travels with its maker.
